localChanges: test: the engine harness can play any plugin set, grid and players, and soak whole games (#1034)

log: The AI imports Civ1's units, improvements, advances and rules to reason about them, but doesn't need those packages loaded as plugins. web-renderer's set resolver reads `civ-clone.importsOnly` and doesn't follow these dependencies from here, so a set built on simple-ai-client (such as a future civ2 set) no longer brings in all of Civ1. The civ1 set names them itself, so it is unchanged.
